description: Move money from a sub-account back to the user's own main account. Not for paying someone from a sub-account (use initiate_payment with source.kind=sub_account). Single-signature sub-accounts only; for a joint account use propose_sub_account_multisig_proposal. Creates a request the user approves in the Moneda mobile app; nothing happens until then. After calling, poll get_payment_status.
name: propose_sub_account_withdraw
